anime.title: Zenchi-teki na Dokusha no Shiten kara
anime.synopsis: Kim Dokja does not consider himself the protagonist of his own life. Befitting the name his parents gave him, he is a solitary person whose sole hobby is reading web novels. For over a decade, he has lived vicariously through Yoo Joonghyuk, the main character of the web novel Three Ways to Survive the Apocalypse (TWSA). Through Joonghyuk, Dokja has experienced secondhand the trials of repeatedly regressing in time, in search of an end to life-threatening "scenarios" that force people to act out narratives for the amusement of god-like "Constellations." After reading 3,149 chapters—long after all other readers lost interest—Dokja finally resigns himself to the story ending. However, he receives an enigmatic message from the author, stating that the story will soon be monetized, before his surroundings suddenly go dark. He swiftly realizes that fiction has become reality and he is now living through TWSA. Although he is the singular omniscient reader of the events yet to come, his success in the scenarios is not guaranteed—but perhaps his advantage will empower him to step into the protagonist role that never suited him before. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

anime.synopsis: Ruri Aoki is just another average high school student—until she wakes one morning to discover horns growing out of her head. Although Ruri has no idea what to make of this sudden development, she decides to go to school like normal, hoping that another ordinary day awaits her. But it does not take long before her best friend, classmates, and homeroom teacher all notice something amiss. Swarmed by people requesting to look at, feel, and take selfies with her horns, Ruri realizes being a half-dragon is going to be much more chaotic than she expected. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

anime.synopsis: The pinnacle of human civilization has come and gone, leaving only ruins in its wake. Society and science now struggle to rebuild, rediscovering scraps of knowledge from powerful ancient artifacts that defy comprehension. These relics of the "Old World" can make the fortunes of those who find them—if ancient security systems and rogue bioweapons don't kill the relic hunters first. Akira, a young street orphan, sets out to become one such hunter to escape his brutal life in the slums. Untrained, malnourished, and poorly armed, Akira would be lucky to make it back from the ruins alive—until an encounter with Alpha, a mysterious, ghostly woman, changes his fate forever. Alpha needs a hunter, and she's willing to train Akira to get one. Will her support be enough to help a penniless kid from the slums climb to the top of a crushing and merciless world? anime.title: Amayo no Tsuki
anime.synopsis: One day, while rushing to a piano lesson, a girl named Saki collides with someone on the street. As Saki collects herself, the stranger picks up the sheet music Saki dropped, hands it to Saki together with a band-aid, and continues on her way—all without saying a word. Saki is left wondering about the identity of the tall, lovely stranger, only to discover the next day that she is one of her classmates at her new high school. The girl's name is Kanon, and though she is hearing impaired, she refuses any kind of support or "special treatment" from her teachers or classmates. Over the course of the year, Saki slowly grows closer to Kanon and begins to chip away at her cold exterior. (Source: Kodansha USA)

anime.title: Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo
anime.synopsis: First-year class president, Otogi Katsura, assumes the role of a pristine and gracious girl with pride. Ever since she was a child, she knew what people expected of a beauty such as herself, and she upholds this virtuous image without fail. The only person to rival Katsura, both in appearance and charm, is her vice president, Toki Ninomae. On top of that, his impeccable manners make him the perfect match for her as the school's madonna—in her opinion at least. Though it appears impossible to prove, Katsura is confident that Ninomae wears a mask just like she does. Her suspicions are soon confirmed when she accidentally exposes her sharp-tongued side, and, encouraged by her boldness, Ninomae follows suit to reveal his brusque and cool nature. From then on, Katsura and Ninomae start to shed their false angel disguises and lower their guard around one another, without realizing how easy it is to fall in love. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

anime.title: Akuyaku Reijou no Naka no Hito
anime.synopsis: Although Emi Kobayashi is heartbroken over her own death, she realizes she has reincarnated as her favorite character from an otome game—the villainess Remilia Rosa Graupner. Emi is kind and generous by nature and therefore determined to give Remilia the life she deserves. Her warmth soon charms every key character, and she ensures Remilia's bright future. For a decade, Remilia has watched over Emi from the inside, satisfied as long as the tender-hearted Emi was happy herself. The arrival of the protagonist, Pina Blanche, envelops Emi's world in darkness. From the beginning, Pina shows her true colors, resorting to underhanded methods to destroy Remilia's reputation until everyone turns against her. When despair overwhelms Emi, control over her body returns to Remilia. But Remilia is not so forgiving that she will simply let Pina have her way. She swears to take revenge and show everyone who wronged Emi the power of a true villainess. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

anime.title: Nisemono no Renkinjutsushi
anime.synopsis: In the city-state of Orichalconia, a world where alchemy and magic are deeply rooted in the lives of the people, the reincarnated Paracelsus ekes out a living as an alchemist while hiding his "cheat skills." However, his life changes dramatically one day after he enters into a contract with a shaman slave-girl, Nora, and later meets Coco, an elf who has lost all four limbs and five senses. To save Coco, what began as a rescue attempt in a small workshop gradually escalates into a battle involving alchemy and sorcery, space and even the gods themselves. (Source: Kadokawa)

anime.title: Majo to Ryouken
anime.synopsis: The mission is to gather seven witches. The Kingdom of Amelia, which monopolizes sorcerers and expands its territory with supernatural power, poses a threat to the small nation of Campusfellow. The lord of Campusfellow, Bud, takes unprecedented action. His plan is to gather the notorious witches scattered across the continent to counter Amelia. At the same time, news arrives that the Mirror Witch has been captured in the neighboring country of Lowe. To take custody of the witch, Bud sets off for Lowe with his attendants. Among them is Rollo, a boy raised as an assassin, known by the nickname "Black Dog." Thus begins a grand and ruthless dark fantasy like no one has ever seen. (Source: Shogakukan)

anime.title: Eleceed
anime.synopsis: Jiwoo is a kind-hearted young man who harnesses the lightning quick reflexes of a cat to secretly make the world a better place—one saved little child or foster pet at a time. Kayden is a secret agent on the run, who finds himself stuck in the body of a...um...decidedly fat old fluffy cat. Together, armed with Jiwoo's super powers and Kayden's uber-smarts, they're out to fight those forces who would let evil rule this world. That is, if they can stand each other long enough to get the job done. (Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

anime.title: Risou no Himo Seikatsu
anime.synopsis: Yamai Zenjirou is your everyday office worker in modern Japan. One morning, he suddenly finds himself summoned to a tropical world where dinosaurs roam the land. He is told that this is the kingdom of Capua and the person who summoned him—its monarch, Queen Aura—wants him to marry her and leave his old life behind for a life of carefree extravagance as her prince consort. The reasons for her offer are many and varied, but she needs an heir, and she wants him to be the one to provide it! If he accepts, he'll never have to work again, lazing around in luxury with no worries other than securing the kingdom its next monarch. Certainly, sleeping with the buxom beauty is far from a hardship, but is everything really as it seems? He'll also need to give up everything he knows on Earth. Is he ready to drop it all at a moment's notice for her sake? And how well will he be able to navigate the politics, people, and culture of this new world if he does? (Source: J-Novel Club, edited)

anime.title: Nyuugaku Youhei
anime.synopsis: When he was eight years old, Yu Ijin was the sole survivor of a fiery plane crash in a foreign land. To survive, he became a notorious mercenary—honing his arm-to-arm capabilities, marksmanship, and combat prowess into those of a skilled predator. However, 10 years later, after encountering soldiers deployed from South Korea, he rediscovers his remaining family: an adorable little sister named Dayun and a warm-hearted grandfather. Upon returning to his home country, a brand new trial is presented to Ijin—to assume the mundane life of a typical high school student. From scheming bullies to newfound friendships, every experience is new for Ijin. However, when his past begins to catch up to him, Ijin will have to use his years of experience on the battlefield to protect his loved ones. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

anime.title: Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e.
anime.synopsis: Everyone in the world is born genderless. But when children hit their 12th birthday, their bodies alter toward their desired gender. One person is an exception to this phenomenon: Hinase Arima, whose anatomy has yet to change upon their 18th spring. Nonetheless, they are satisfied with this, as long as they have their two childhood friends—the joyfully cute girl Ritsu Kaga and the stubbornly tall boy Shiori Takayama. With their last year of high school on the horizon, Hinase expects that their life will remain unchanged. Yet, this expectation is quickly swept away when they are confessed to by Ritsu and Shiori on the same day! Having never held romantic or sexual desires, Hinase is clueless on how to answer both of their confessions. However, time is running out, and Hinase must soon make the crucial decision: to choose between becoming a boy or a girl. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

anime.title: Mukuwarenakatta Murabito A, Kizoku ni Hirowarete Dekiai sareru Ue ni, Jitsu wa Motteita Densetsu-kyuu no Kami Skill mo Kakusei shita
anime.synopsis: Matteo, who was supposed to be just a common villager, is reborn as the grandson of an imperial aristocrat, Lawrence. He spends his days being doted on by his powerful grandfather. With his immense magical powers, Matteo rapidly hatches a dragon egg and tames the dragon, naming it Eva. When his magical abilities are measured, it's revealed that he possesses the strongest magic power ever recorded! He quickly learns how to use magic, reviving ancient spells and effortlessly drawing the most powerful sword that absorbs magic, making it the strongest. Matteo is also favored by the emperor he meets, but the emperor holds a secret—? Clever, illustrious, strong, as expected! The life of the most beloved noble, where everything is affirmed, boldly begins! (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Sensou Kyoushitsu
anime.synopsis: In Arboral Year 1294, the world is dominated by nine massive towers known as the Spires, remnants of an ancient civilization. Filled with lost secrets and powerful knowledge, nations struggle to possess them. Luca is a bugler in a mercenary company who wants nothing more than to leave the battlefield behind and become a true musician, a maestro. But marked as one of the enigmatic Branch-hexed, and gifted with the strange ability to see the sound of his instrument, Luca finds himself drawn reluctantly into a war of epic proportions! (Source: VIZ Media)

anime.title: The Boxer
anime.synopsis: Having suffered ruthless bullying for the better part of his life, 17-year-old Yu has become emotionally numb and dissociated from reality, no longer able to act like a normal human being. Although he possesses the exceptional talent to dodge punches, Yu prefers to let his perpetrators beat him down as he finds no meaning in his survival. Things begin to look up when Yu meets an old boxing trainer nicknamed "K." Having raised five champions, K's years of experience and an impressive gut feeling allow him to recognize Yu's near-superhuman fighting charisma immediately. K rushes to take Yu under his wing, despite the latter's apparent lack of interest. However, after being reminded of a bright memory from the past, Yu has a change of heart and accepts K's offer, hoping to experience the same light once again. Thus, Yu enters a world full of formidable adversaries—righteous and monstrous alike—and for the first time ever, he has no choice but to fight back. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

anime.title: Here U Are
anime.synopsis: Yu Yang is a second-year university student who seems reliable and pleasant. With the commencement of a new term, he is tasked with orienting every freshman he sees on campus. Eventually, his duty leads him to meet Li Huan, a new student with a fairly oppressive height. Besides his intimidating physique, he is taciturn, aloof, and often gives Yu Yang the cold shoulder. Yu Yang, who has done nothing but assist him, immediately grows frustrated by this treatment. However, despite his initial impressions, Yu Yang believes that his chance encounter with Li Huan will transform his future outlook—perhaps even on the prospect of love. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

anime.title: Junket Bank
anime.synopsis: Karasu Bank is one of Japan's leading banks, boasting the third-highest operating profits in the country. Akira Mitarai is a young employee in his second year at the bank's central branch. His exceptional math skills allow him to instantly spot accounting errors but also make his day-to-day life incredibly boring. One day, Akira is suddenly transferred to the Special Operations Department's "Appraisal Unit," which he is told is a key department within the bank. Suspicious of his transfer and the unfamiliar department, he is told by his new boss that the bank actually operates a massive underground casino, and that the Appraisal Unit is the department responsible for managing this gambling as well as the gamblers who participate in it. But these gamblers are putting more than just their money on the line, with their very lives serving as collateral to play! Higher risk means higher rewards, but at the top level losing is a death sentence. Overwhelmed and confused by the strange state of the bank's secret casino, Mitarai meets a mysterious, genius gambler, Shin Mafutsu. Enraptured by Shin's ability to see through his opponents' cheating and emerge victorious, Akira decides to enter the world of life-or-death gambling as Shin's bank representative. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Otome Game no Heroine de Saikyou Survival
anime.synopsis: Orphaned by a monster attack on her village, young Alicia spends three horrid years in an orphanage before finally running away. When she flees, however, Alicia has a violent encounter with an older woman hell-bent on killing her. During their tussle, she comes into contact with a strange crystal that bestows upon her a wealth of knowledge, transforming her from an innocent child into a cool and calculated planner. Now aware that she was meant to be the protagonist of an otome game and disgusted with her supposed fate, Alicia decides to take matters into her own hands and become strong—by any means necessary. Using her newfound knowledge, and with some help from a stranger she meets in the woods, she learns to survive by herself in a world far too harsh and unforgiving for a girl her age. Ready or not, she's determined to carve her own path. (Source: J-Novel Club)

anime.title: Saikyou Mahoushi no Inton Keikaku
anime.synopsis: In a world where the Fiends run rampant... Magicmaster Alus Reigin, the young prodigy that has defeated more Fiends and reclaimed more of humanity's lost territory than anyone else alive, requests retirement from military service at age 16. But due to the twists and turns of fate surrounding his status as the No. 1 Magicmaster in the nation—the top Magicmaster out of more than 100,000—he ends up as a student at a special magical institute, hiding his identity and training his successors – a pair of beautiful Magicmaster girls! Not to mention continuing to defeat Fiends in secret... Get ready—the epic adventure of the Greatest Magicmaster Alus Reigin begins now! (Source: J-Novel Club)

anime.title: Girl Crush
anime.synopsis: Tenka Momose, a high school freshman that can sing and dance... she's pretty and smart to boot! She's good at everything but love. One day she meets Erian Satou, and was pulled in by her passionate dedication to becoming an idol. This is the story about two young girls chasing after their K-Pop idol dream!! (Source: Comikey Media)

anime.title: Hone Dragon no Mana Musume
anime.synopsis: In the Forest of Scraps, a place where all manner of things are discarded, an old dragon sleeps away his final days—that is, until an abandoned child suddenly appears before him. The tiny human is Eve, and despite being only five years of age, she has somehow endured the many dangers that surround them. In an act of pity, the dragon decides to raise her as his own...but his time is still running out. After five years together, he takes his last breath, leaving his precious daughter on her own. Little does the dragon know, Eve is capable of more than he realizes, and their reunion may be sooner than he thinks... Hoping to improve Eve's control over her magical abilities before his resurrected body gives out, the skull dragon sets out on an adventure with his reckless human daughter—but who knows what kind of trouble awaits them? (Source: J-Novel Club)

anime.title: Ma no Mono-tachi wa Kuwadateru
anime.synopsis: People don't truly appreciate the amount of R&D that goes into making traps. I mean, you can't let the heroes waltz up to the demon lord unscathed, can you? Do you know how much logistical work goes into keeping the traps armed? In coming up with new, innovative ways to scathe, maim, and humiliate the humans? From slime that melts your clothes, to titillating tentacle traps-Follow along with the Demon Lord's underlings as they devise, concoct, and scheme up all new ways to strike fear in an adventurer's heart. (Source: Yen Press)

anime.title: IDOLiSH7 4th Season
anime.synopsis: Fourth season of IDOLiSH7.

anime.title: S-Rank Party kara Kaiko sareta "Jugushi"
anime.synopsis: Gail Hamilton is a "curse crafter" who got booted from his party for allegedly not pulling his weight...right after they were promoted to the Guild's "S" rank. Unfortunately, the party didn't realize that Gail's cursed goods pack the power of holy relics and legendary gear! But too bad for them, because Gail's going it alone now...and causing a sensation with the creepy-yet-useful curses he works with! (Source: Kodansha)

anime.title: Akuyaku no Ending wa Shi nomi
anime.synopsis: The latest otome game is all the rage recently, so a regular university student decides to see for herself if its fame is well-deserved. She clears the normal mode in no time and finds herself pitying the villainess, Penelope Eckhart. Penelope is a fake―a replacement for the duke's missing daughter, the protagonist of the game. Initially confident about clearing the hard mode as well, the woman is shocked by the sheer leap in the level of difficulty, eventually passing out from exhaustion. However, when she wakes up, she no longer recognizes her surroundings, for she has been reincarnated into the body of the villainess! In a world where everyone seems to be out for her blood, Penelope must make wise decisions that keep her away from the death route. A tyrant prince, a suspicious magician, a nobleman from a fallen nation, or one of her nasty adoptive brothers―whose affections will she win? [Written by MAL Rewrite]

anime.title: Gekkakoku Kiiden
anime.synopsis: In the faraway lands of the Moon Flower Kingdom, people have long relied on healing methods shrouded in superstition with dubious results. When the young Prince Keiun goes in search of more reliable remedies, his party is attacked by mysterious assailants, and he ends up witnessing a never-before-seen lifesaving procedure that shocks him to the core. Even more surprising, the one who performs this medical feat is a beautiful, yet slightly odd, teenage girl named Koyou! Just who is this girl, and why is the prince being targeted by assassins? Shadowy conspiracies, medical intrigue, and romance abound in this beautifully illustrated shoujo manga! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

anime.title: Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi.
anime.synopsis: Noa Saotome is an art director at a gaming company. Highly trusted by her boss and admired by her juniors for her work ethic, she is the definition of a successful, high-flying career woman. But in reality, she's hiding a completely different side. Rihito Otsuka, a second-year employee whose life motto is energy conservation, accidentally catches a glimpse of the secret side Noa keeps fiercely hidden from the world. That chance encounter sparks an after-hours friendship between the two. Can a genuine bond truly form between a burnt-out career woman and a detached, low-energy guy?! (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Akutou Ikka no Manamusume, Tensei-saki mo Otome Game no Gokudou Reijou deshita. Saijoukyuu Rank no Akuyaku-sama, Sono Dekiai wa Fuyou desu!
anime.synopsis: A girl whose greatest wish was simply to have friends is reincarnated into a game world set in a mafia-controlled early modern era. In her new life, she becomes Francesca, the beloved daughter of one of the Five Great Families that secretly support the monarchy. Her hopes for a peaceful life are quickly shattered. As soon as the game's main story begins, she is kidnapped by Leonardo, her fiancé—and the story's most dangerous antagonist. However, instead of treating her as an enemy, Leonardo unexpectedly offers to become her "friend." Excited at the chance to gain her first real friend, Francesca throws herself into changing the game's deadly storyline. Drawing on her bold personality and strong sense of loyalty from her previous life, she works to avoid the bad endings awaiting her. What begins as an attempt to make a friend soon becomes something more complicated, as a former yakuza granddaughter and a ruthless young mafia boss find themselves bound together in a dangerous game where friendship and romance begin to blur. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Koisuru (Otome) no Tsukurikata
anime.synopsis: Kenshirou Midou is a popular student who harbors a secret: despite being a boy, he has always loved the art of cosmetics. Because of his efforts to keep this low profile, only his sisters and Hiura Mihate, a childhood friend, know his hidden obsession. Apart from his siblings, Hiura is Kenshirou's only hope at realizing his potential. Kenshirou begs Hiura to let him practice applying makeup on him, and when Hiura finally succumbs to his request, the drastic transformation shocks Kenshirou. From the appearance of a dull, slender boy to a charming petite girl, Hiura's new look evokes something in Kenshirou. On the other hand, Hiura has had feelings for Kenshirou long before his dramatic change. Often watching from the sidelines, Hiura thinks that a romantic relationship with him is beyond his reach. But with the revelation of Kenshirou's unusual hobby, Hiura remains optimistic and decides to devote himself to his friend's passion. As their affection for one another intensifies, the pair slowly develops an unbreakable bond. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

anime.title: Maiden Blood
anime.synopsis: Armageddon has overturned the world's destiny, where an Evil God has risen after gaining power from the ego of humans who feared death. As a result, eight billion people were sacrificed, leaving only a handful of survivors to exist merely as playthings for the god in a world shrouded in eternal darkness. In this twisted world where logic is gone, human blood has become everything—from currency and fuel to a forbidden weapon forged by sorcerers to eradicate demons. Eva and Epica are a pair of sisters bound by a tragic fate in the midst of this apocalypse. The younger sister, Epica, is the ultimate blood-battle human who has lost her soul, while the older sister, Eva, was born unable to walk. However, only Eva's blood can awaken Epica's power to fight against the demons that have defiled the world. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Studio Cabana
anime.synopsis: Yukari Maki is a high school girl who prides herself on honesty—and she's starting to get the feeling that she and her delinquent classmate, Yuusuke Kusaka, don't have a single thing in common! But her straitlaced unwillingness to let him skate by in school earns her an almost chaperone-like reputation, and his apparent disdain. Yet, despite Yuusuke's disapproval of her hovering, Yukari refuses to let a new rumor about him spread. After following Yuusuke home to discuss it, she watches him stop at a music studio. And there, Yukari sees—and hears—a side of Yuusuke she had never imagined... (Source: Yen Press)

anime.title: Boukensha License wo Hakudatsu sareta Ossan dakedo, Manamusume ga Dekita node Nonbiri Jinsei wo Ouka suru
anime.synopsis: Douglas, once known as a legendary enhancement spellcaster, is now little more than your average, weak old man. On top of that, he was kicked out of the hero party, and eventually had his adventurer's license revoked... And that's how he ended up a vagabond, wandering aimlessly. After an encounter with Rabi, a cursed little girl, a new adventure begins... (Source: Square Enix)

anime.title: Soara to Mamono no Ie
anime.synopsis: Soara is a young orphan girl who was raised by knights and trained to battle the monsters that constantly attacked their kingdom. But by the time Soara is ready to join the fight herself, peace has been declared and her blade is no longer needed. Searching for a new home and a new purpose, Soara stumbles across Krik the dwarf, leader of the Monster Architects. Suddenly, instead of fighting monsters, Soara finds herself working with Krik to build comfortable homes for them! In the process, will she discover a new home and family for herself? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

anime.title: Namidaame to Serenade
anime.synopsis: On rainy days, Hina Katagiri always dreams about her younger self playing with a mysterious boy, but she assumes these thoughts are nothing more than a childhood fantasy. Now a high school student, she focuses on her club activities and protecting her great-grandmother's necklace. While at school, Hina is inexplicably transported to the backyard of a mansion, where she is greeted by one of its inhabitants, Takaaki Hongou. He mistakes the girl for his fiancée, Hinako Kitamine, but Hina, believing she is in a dream, plays along with the misunderstanding. It is when Hina comes face-to-face with the real Hinako that she realizes the severity of her situation: somehow, she has been sent to the year 1907. In addition, she has lost her heirloom necklace at Takaaki's house. With Hinako's assistance, Hina continues to masquerade as her in order to access the Hongou household. However, Hina's plan begins to fall apart when she starts to develop feelings for Takaaki, all while the path to her former life becomes increasingly uncertain. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

anime.title: Hokuto no Ken: Fist of the North Star Part 2
anime.synopsis: Second part of Hokuto no Ken: Fist of the North Star.

anime.title: Zeikin de Katta Hon
anime.synopsis: Ishidaira is a delinquent who visited the library for the first time since elementary school. He discovered that he still hadn't returned a book he borrowed 10 years ago. He ended up having to work part-time at the library to pay for it. This is the beginning of a manga that makes you want to go to the library after you read it. (Source: Kodansha, translated)

anime.title: Watashi wo Center ni Suru to Chikaimasu ka?
anime.synopsis: "If you can really make me the Center...then we can get married." Meet Mizuki Natsuno, the least popular member of the nationally acclaimed idol group, Melty Strawberry. She has an eternal fan in Koichi Okuta, who is always pouring heart and soul into supporting her. Normally, a fan would never get to interact with their idol beyond the stage. But one thing led to another, and Koichi now finds himself living together with Mizuki in his own house. He vows to make her the new Center of Melty Strawberry, sparking an unconventional tag-team between a devoted fan and his idol. Together, they attempt to elevate Mizuki's career from obscurity to stardom! (Source: Kodansha)

anime.title: Hokuhokusei ni Kumo to Ike
anime.synopsis: Seventeen-year-old Kei Miyama comes from a family with strange abilities. Birds flock to his grandfather as if he is the wind that carries them in the air itself. Kei, on the other hand, can talk to cars and prefers their company to humans—especially women. After moving to Iceland, Kei makes a living there as a freelance detective. Whether it be resolving lovers' quarrels, locating missing people, or recovering lost items, Kei hops from case to case, traveling alone on the empty roads that span the rugged Icelandic landscape. But the secrets of the land of ice and fire are not the only mysteries ahead that Kei must unravel: an encounter with an aloof Icelandic beauty makes him recall local superstitions of ghosts that roam the wild lands at night. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

anime.title: Wataridori to Katatsumuri
anime.synopsis: Unpei Mochizuki, a second-year employee at a machine part wholesaler, makes a mistake that causes problems for his clients. Feeling upset, he thinks about running away to a place where no one knows him. That's when he meets Tsugumi Nagisa, a picture book author with a youthful face and glasses, who travels around with her dog in her car, which they use as their home. They spend their days on the road, living in the car and enjoying a new way of traveling, free from any schedule. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: 7-nin no Nemurihime
anime.synopsis: In the enchanting Kingdom of Amaryllis, a wandering prince embarks on a noble quest to break an ancient curse that bewitched the land. His mission: to awaken the princess with a true love's kiss. There's just one tiny detail no one warned him about—there are seven princesses to kiss! Undeterred, he takes up the challenge and finds himself living amongst them to unravel the mystery behind the kingdom's slumbering state. Will they all eventually find their happily ever after? (Source: MU)

anime.title: 8-gatsu 31-nichi no Long Summer
anime.synopsis: Two high schoolers, Suzuki-kun and Takagi-san, met in a time loop on August 31st. They are the only ones who can retain their memories when the day repeats itself. A possible cause of the time loop is Suzuki-kun's unfinished business for the summer, a guy's greatest objective... A time loop comedy of youth that tackles love head-on! (Source: Kodansha)

anime.title: Kamisama Gakkou no Ochikobore
anime.synopsis: Modern life means modern solutions—even to supernatural problems. So of course the government would have a classification system, special schools, and licenses for people with mysterious powers. Any manifestation of a miracle is enough to be called a Himiko, but only those with full certification may use the title of god. And high schooler Nagi is in serious need of a god! The death of her grandmother has left her family shrine devoid of the necessary divinity, and her hopelessly shut-in Himiko brother isn't looking promising. But if Nagi isn't careful, her search for a god might end with her finding more than she bargained for... (Source: Yen Press)

anime.title: Fuun kara no Saikyou Otoko
anime.synopsis: "Fortune and Misfortune are two sides of the same coin?! Reverse any adversary and cease redemption!!" Siegbert is reborn after an unfortunate accident in his previous life. His new family is warm and welcoming... so much so it seems as though he may no longer be an unlucky person. In this world, he can finally live a quiet, peaceful life... or so he thought. It seems that he actually holds an insanely high luck stat in this new world...? "Every chance is a manifestation of good fortune. If you can cease the chances, your wishes shall be granted..." Conquering each "chance" granted by his good fortune, will he now cease redemption on the generational legacy this family has yet to fulfill?! (Source: Starts Shuppan)

anime.title: J⇔Ｍ
anime.synopsis: J is a legendary hitman who is feared in the underworld as "untouchable." One day, while walking on the street, he accidentally collides into a lonely elementary school girl named Megumi. However, because of the accident, they switch bodies. J is now forced to go through the life of the schoolgirl Megumi, while Megumi is now forced to go through the life of the hitman J. One chaotic and comical situation after another ensues as they go through each other's life. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Kin to Tetsu
anime.synopsis: Dante's life on Amigasa seemed normal enough to him, even though everyone around him called him an oddball. But when a chance meeting with a young woman named Aoi changes everything, Dante can no longer sit idly by...unless, of course, he is made to! (Source: Kodansha USA)

anime.title: Real mo Tama ni wa Uso wo Tsuku
anime.synopsis: Nanami and uses a male avatar. Kaoru has been lying about his identity, and the two will soon meet in real life for the first time. When the day finally arrives, they realize that their expectations are quite different from reality. Contrary to Kaoru's expectations, Nanami turns out to be a girl. With their genders revealed, they are both in shock—especially Nanami. She has already told her enthusiastic mother and overprotective father about her female friend coming to their house. Consequently, Nanami comes up with an idea to mask Kaoru's true gender: crossdressing! Even though their friendship started with lies, this odd meetup marks the beginning of their unusual bond. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

anime.title: Saikon Shounin wo Youkyuu Shimasu
anime.synopsis: Empress of the Eastern Nation Navier Ellie Trovi stands at the pinnacle of noblewomen with dignity and grace. Although she and her husband, Emperor Sovieshu, are not as intimate as other couples, their trust in each other has been built over years of friendship. But then, wanting something more, he brings in a concubine—a former slave named Rashta—and that is when everything begins to fall apart. Months later, the fateful day arrives; Sovieshu declares his intentions to divorce Navier and give her throne to Rashta. However, against all expectations, Navier is not backed against a wall, and she declares her intention to marry another man—Heinrey—whose noble appearance shocks all in the room. Just who is Heinrey, and how did Navier come to this new marriage arrangement? The Eastern Nation stands at a precipice, being torn apart by conspiracies, lies, and—above all—love. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

anime.title: Odekake Hololive
anime.synopsis: "Where shall we go today?" The unique girls of the VTuber agency "Hololive Production" are usually seen behind screens during their livestreams. However, on their days off, it seems they head out to explore various places? Traveling across Japan through all four seasons, eating delicious food, laughing together, and visiting places they have yet to discover! An omnibus travel story depicting their exceptionally lively and fun outings! (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito
anime.synopsis: Sora Akizuki, a second-year high school student, gets rejected by his junior and crush, Miya Fuwa, because she is in love with Asahi Suzukaze—the president of the "Clinical Trials Club." To learn more, Sora decides to join the mysterious club. There, he is shocked to discover that Asahi actually has a crush on the "Clinical Trials Prince," a boy who saved her through a clinical trial program when she was sick as a child. Unbeknownst to anyone, the childhood prince Asahi is looking for is actually Sora himself back in elementary school. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Toratsugumi: Tsugumi Project
anime.synopsis: In the distant future, the region once known as Japan has transformed into a deadly wasteland teeming with high radiation and bizarre monsters. This forbidden zone has long been uninhabitable for humans. The story centers on Leon, a man framed for a crime he didn't commit, torn away from his wife and child, and sent to death row. To survive, he is forced to take on a highly classified, perilous mission with only two outcomes: success or death. In the heart of this lethal territory, Leon encounters a variety of strange creatures—from a mysterious young girl to colossal beasts—that will forever change his fate. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Juuheisou-gata Joshikousei
anime.synopsis: As a mysterious girl gazes into the distant sky and a high school girl named Ichi stands still, the story follows what they will see within this devastated world and what kind of tale they will weave. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Kyoukai no Melody
anime.synopsis: After losing his musical partner Kai in an accident just before their major debut, Kyousuke has distanced himself from music and lives without motivation. Three years later, Kai suddenly appears before Kyousuke, unchanged and as outspoken as ever. "Being alive but doing nothing... that's no different from being dead." Encouraged by Kai's words, Kyousuke returns to the world of music, rediscovering the joy of creating sound together. But their time together cannot last forever... (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Phantom Busters
anime.synopsis: In search of a fourth member for the club, Mogari, Eugene, and new recruit Kaoru Kanzaki set their sights on Koutarou Tamon, a classmate who seems to be able to talk to ghosts. Unfortunately, Kotaro's got some major problems communicating with living humans! Will Kotaro be able to overcome his anxiety and join the Phantom Busters? (Source: VIZ Media)

anime.title: Decapolice
anime.synopsis: DECASIM, a virtual world created from a perfect copy of reality. More than just a simulation, it's a complete copy of a real city, a forbidden place where memories of every past crime lie dormant. "Clues" found in DECASIM can help unravel the riddles of the real world. (Source: Official site)

anime.title: Saijaku na Boku wa "Kabenuke Bug" de Nariagaru
anime.synopsis: The series follows Henri Cleats, an adventurer who only has a single skill: Evasion. Wanting to take care of his sickly younger sister Colette, he joins a party. However, due to weak attack power and lack of skills, he is expelled from this party. However, it turns out that his evasion skill comes with a bonus: he is able to pass through walls and reach the end of dungeons without defeating the boss. Thus, he is able to claim a dungeon's First Clear bonus more than once. With his newfound knowledge, Henri sets out to clear as many dungeons as he can while also leveling up his power. (Source: Wikipedia)

anime.title: Itou Junji: Crimson
anime.synopsis: (No synopsis yet.)

anime.title: Re:bel Robotica
anime.synopsis: Robotica. Machines made in the very likeness of humankind. Robotica. Beings that exist to serve humanity. Robotica. Created to bring people happiness. The year 2050—In a near-future Tokyo where dramatic leaps in information technology have promised every person a comfortable, contented life: Shibuya. An enigmatic girl named Lily. Her very existence will shake the world. (Source: Press Release)

anime.title: S-Rank Boukensha de Aru Ore no Musume-tachi wa Juudo no Fathercon deshita
anime.synopsis: During a quest to subdue wyverns, A-rank adventurer Kaiser Clyde witnesses an ancient dragon awaken from its slumber, fly to a nearby village, and immediately destroy it. In the aftermath, Kaiser frantically searches for survivors and finds three babies among the rubble. Feeling responsible for the deaths of the village's populace, Kaiser decides to retire and take care of the children as his daughters. Bestowing upon them the names Elsa, Anna, and Meryl, Kaiser raises the girls with as much love and affection as he can give. As the years pass, each of his daughters' talents begins to rapidly develop in swordsmanship, management, and magic, respectively. However, despite their unique dispositions, Elsa, Anna, and Meryl all have one thing in common: their overflowing love for their father that seemingly exceeds simple familial bonds. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

anime.title: Mamonotsukai no Musume
anime.synopsis: Veteran adventurer Hakura has overcome countless trials, but his latest fight with a deadly hydra nearly costs him his life. In the nick of time, he is saved by an intriguing young lady named Leen, who, to his surprise, possesses the rare ability to tame any and all monsters! Now indebted to this unscrupulous monstermancer, Hakura decides to join her in her travels, the two of them arguing and bickering every step of the way. What has drawn them together, and what adventures await this unlikely pair? (Source: J-Novel Club)

anime.title: Vampire Juujikai
anime.synopsis: There is a legend that tells of how the world was almost destroyed thousands of years ago by the vampire queen after she unleashed her latent powers. Despite their efforts, the humans were unable to defeat her, and thus resorted to sealing her away until the time came that they would be powerful enough to destroy the seal and kill her. However, the humans are not the only ones after the seal. Having cast aside his kingdom and betraying his own race and the dhampirs (half-vampires), the vampire king is persistently searching, even to this day, for where his queen has been sealed away so he may break the seal and free her before the humans do. Fearing that once the king and queen are reunited, they shall continue to destroy the world together, the humans and dhampirs hunt the king, using any method possible. (Source: Anime Source)

anime.title: E, Shanai System Subete One Operation shiteiru Watashi wo Kaiko desu ka?
anime.synopsis: Ai Satou is the sole engineer maintaining her company's internal systems. It's too bad being the linchpin who keeps it all running won't protect her from sudden layoffs. Apparently, the new CEO doesn't approve of cosplaying at work. Depressed and jobless, Ai unexpectedly reunites with her childhood friend, Kenta Suzuki, who makes her an offer. His startup, True Coding School, provides personalized lessons to people struggling under the stress of modern society, and he wants her to join his team. With every passionate—and sometimes unconventional—lecture, Ai finds herself giving her students a renewed sense of purpose. Who knew that coding lessons could change so many lives? (Source: J-Novel Club)

anime.title: Destiny Unchain Online
anime.synopsis: Kou Mitsuki is a gamer with god-tier skills, known online as Crim the Headhunter. Right when he starts testing his father's latest game, Destiny Unchain Online, and the new device developed for it, the bug-ridden system transforms him in into a vampire girl! Everything changes for Kou as he meets new friends and they take on the game... The ultimate gamer adventure awaits! (Source: Kodansha)

anime.title: Tsuihou sareta Shounin wa Kane no Chikara de Sekai wo Sukuu
anime.synopsis: Torao is a merchant in the S-rank adventurer party, Blue Ring. He is kicked out of the group after being caught secretly providing financial support to Garnet, a rookie all-female adventurer party. Following his exile, Torao leaves them with a stern warning, but Blue Ring ignores it and recklessly challenges the Demon King, leading to their total annihilation. Torao subsequently joins Garnet. Ironically, their very first mission is to head to the front lines to salvage valuable equipment from the corpses of the wiped-out Blue Ring members. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Mahoutsukai Rosé no Sado Life
anime.synopsis: The story begins when Rosé is transported from another world to Japan. Right after arriving, she is attacked by a bird, but she's saved by a local resident named Sana Tsuchiya. Since Rosé has just arrived and lacks both money and any sense of her surroundings, she ends up moving in with Sana. At first, after watching TV at Sana's house, Rosé assumes she has been transported to Tokyo—but in reality, she is on Sado Island. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Shin Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo
anime.synopsis: Ryoutsu, being an underpaid policeman, is always coming up with underhanded schemes in order to make a quick buck. But in the end, his plans (which are ridiculous to begin with) always go wrong and land him in big trouble with the chief.

anime.title: Soshiki no Shukuteki to Kekkon shitara Mecha Amai
anime.synopsis: "...I hate you!" "What a coincidence. So do I." The two once belonged to opposing organizations of supernatural power users, and fought for their own opposing goals. Roushi Saikawa, also known as the "Feather Hunter," and Ritsuka Yanagi, the strongest supernatural power user known as the "White Demon." The two spent their days battling each other and had no normal social experience, but... "I love you, Rou-kun." "Me too, Ritsuka." After their organization was disbanded, they somehow started dating and then got married! Is their hatred 100 times more adorable? Now, they are the epitome of a lovey-dovey couple, kissing each other at the door every morning when they go to work. But the husband had just one problem. That is, he had never shared a bed with his wife... In other words, even though he was married, he was still a virgin! This is the story of the hardships faced by such a husband, who gets caught up in numerous troubles but continues to make desperate attempts to deepen his love with his strict wife. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

anime.title: Kinnikuman: Kanpeki Choujin Shiso-hen Season 3
anime.synopsis: Third season of Kinnikuman: Kanpeki Chоujin Shiso-hen.

anime.title: Gifted
anime.synopsis: Natsuki Amakusa is a talented young detective with the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department. One day, he meets Yuuya Shiki, a high school student with a mysterious ability to see "marks" on murderers. After Yuuya helps solve a complex murder case, Natsuki decides to recruit him. The two team up as partners to investigate various criminal cases while working to uncover the mystery behind Yuuya's hidden power. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Omae, Tanuki ni Naranee ka?
anime.synopsis: A series of encounters with Koganemaru, a magical tanuki that saves the hearts of those in need.

anime.title: Nue no Onmyouji
anime.synopsis: Gakurou Yajima has been able to see genyou, a kind of youkai that nobody else notices, since he was a child. He's learned to live with it. Then he starts high school, and the school turns out to have a room that no one knows about. Someone has been living in it. She's a genyou named Nue, a girl who loves video games and has spent years sitting in that room waiting for a person to find it. Gakurou does, and the two of them meet. From there the story follows Gakurou and Nue around the school grounds as he takes his first steps as a modern-day onmyouji. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Odoru Sennen Kazoku
anime.synopsis: Seven immortal siblings born in England possess humanity's ultimate dream: eternal life. But their gift makes them targets for the criminal underworld, corrupt hospitals, and international military organizations! After centuries apart, this extraordinary family reunites for a thrilling new chapter in their lives. (Source: Orange Inc.)

anime.title: Delta to Gamma no Rigakubu Note
anime.synopsis: Shou Izuta, a first-year student at Tsuna Nagai High School who is determined to revive his school's Biology Club. Together with his classmate Rio Iwama and the other club members, they set out to solve various school mysteries. They begin by investigating a legendary match-making cherry blossom tree that has suddenly vanished, using logical and scientific methods. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Senren＊Banka
anime.synopsis: Deep in the mountains lies Hoori, a small village so remote that no trains stop there. Due to its isolation, it has resisted the spread of civilization. However, its rustic charm and hot springs have transformed it into a famous tourist destination. One of the village's biggest draws is the divine blade Murasamemaru, stuck in a stone from which no one has been able to pull it out of... until our protagonist Masaomi Arichi manages to break it in half. Before he can even come to grips with what just happened, he's forced to make amends for what he's done. How, you might ask? By marrying the village's shrine maiden, of course! He's already in way over his head, but this is just the start of his mysterious and unfathomable new life in this village. Masaomi then goes on to meet his new fiance, discovers an enigmatic and strange girl that only he can touch, and begins to learn about the curse afflicting the village of Hoori. Amidst this hectic new life, who will he set his heart on? The answers he seeks lie within the legendary sword in his hands. (Source: Neko Nyan, edited)

anime.title: Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara
anime.synopsis: Meet Juntaro, a Japanese fishing addict who was born and raised in what is perceived to be one of the roughest parts of Japan. It is through his lens where you can experience various parts of the world, their culture, and of course their food. He particularly loves to visit countries and cities that are also believed to be highly dangerous due to his personal belief that they will absolutely have delicious food. Because this was intended for a Japanese audience, you will also get to witness various worldviews unique to Japan alongside it all. There's just one problem: he has extreme brainrot and views the world through a cute anime girl filter. (Source: MU)

anime.title: Yurayura Q
anime.synopsis: Kyuuko is a young fox girl born to a divine fox messenger and a human. Surrounded by her eight talented and beautiful older siblings, who all adore her, Kyuuko can't help but feel ordinary by comparison. She also struggles to use Charm, the foxes' special power of transformation. Although her childhood friend Haru accepts and loves her just as she is, Kyuuko still lacks confidence in herself. As she learns to overcome her insecurities, she also helps the humans, foxes, divine messengers, and even gods around her with their own worries. This heartwarming comedy follows Kyuuko's everyday adventures as she gradually learns to accept herself while bringing smiles to those around her. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Funsou deshitara Hatta made
anime.synopsis: In a chaotic modern world filled with border disputes, ethnic conflicts, and criminal cartels, geopolitical risk consultant Yuri Hatta travels the globe to resolve various crises. From remote regions steeped in superstition to cutting-edge metropolitan cities, Yuri tackles unpredictable disputes that defy common sense. Relying on her sharp intellect, deep knowledge of geopolitics, and occasional pro-wrestling moves, she uncovers the realities of the world—while exploring local and bizarre cuisines along the way. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Zero Rise
anime.synopsis: Zero Rise is about a group of young athletes who have lost their place in the basketball world due to past mistakes and harsh realities. In a society where the divide between wealth and poverty is stark, these determined players must battle against the odds in a cutthroat underground league known as "Zero Rise." As they fight not only for their dreams but for redemption and a shot at a brighter future, they must navigate treacherous challenges that demand both skill and integrity. In this unforgiving world, they are forced to discover what it truly means to rise from the streets—leaving them with one final question: will they find their second chance, or will the rules of survival break them? (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Monster no Niku wo Kutteitara Oui ni Tsuita Ken
anime.synopsis: The first prince of the kingdom of Farune, Mars, is only twelve years old, yet he lives in fear of assassination. In order to avoid the deadly poison in nearly all of his meals, he slips out of the castle into the nearby monster-infested forest, where, battling monsters and his own hunger, he has to hunt for his meals in order to stave off starvation. Then, one night, as he's searching for his next bite of monster meat, a red-haired woman shouldering a greatsword appears before him and says to him, "You have promise. Become my apprentice." How is he supposed to tell her that this must be some sort of mistake? But there's a secret that only she knows, and that he's stumbled upon: eating monsters makes you stronger! With her training and his newfound power, Mars will finally overcome all those pesky assassination attempts. However, that doesn't end things; no, it's only the beginning of a nationwide—even continent-spanning—series of wars and plots with him right in the middle! (Source: Cross Infinite World, edited)

But when the young boy is bullied for his art, Tatsuhiko swears to never draw in front of others ever again. Desperate to find something new to fill the void in his heart, he turns to music but eventually becomes jaded by his own mediocrity. While Tatsuhiko is out drinking with his friends, his sob story earns the ire of a drunk woman, who intimidates the young man into reassessing his attitude toward life. He decides to give animation another chance and soon rediscovers his love for the medium, pushing himself to publish a short video. Tatsuhiko is stunned when the video goes viral, even more so when his favorite singer, Nico Kashiwagi, requests a collaboration on her next music video! Excited to finally meet the artist he has admired for so long, the young man is shocked to discover that Nico is the same bar patron that gave him an earful, though she has no recollection of that drunken night. While initially hesitant of their new partnership, Tatsuhiko slowly learns that there is more to Nico's brutish passion than he realizes. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

anime.title: Death Stranding: Isolation

These events wipe out nations as well as civilization itself. People who remain are now isolated, withdrawn, and without connections. As humanity stands at the brink, a legendary porter sets out to transport both cargo and wishes of its senders, reconnecting people in the hope that they might still be saved. Somewhere in North America, just as Sam Bridges walks through the continent in order to save America, the others are also trying to deal with their isolation in their own way. An old man trying to realize salvation through ways outside of the connection advocated by Bridges. A female warrior who tries to kickstart a world of constant fighting. A boy with a grudge against Bridges. A girl who embraces loneliness. On the precipice of the end of humanity and the world, their fates and hopes converge, as another story of Death Stranding begins. Luo Feng repelled the encirclement with the Star Tower defense, the Wings of Wu Assassination Blockade, the Golden Claw God for close combat, and the Lie Yuan Technique for suppression. He witnessed the cruel mechanism of the beast devouring evolution—in the end, only a single king would be born. The outer defense lines of the universe were attacked, forcing the humans, crystals, and other races to jointly defend the small universe, while Hong, Thunder God, and Xu Xin stabilized Earth's rear. King candidate Bedi appears, stronger and more skilled at manipulating his own kind, mocking Morosa for bowing to "food" and trying to devour it. Luo Feng and Bedi fought head-on, saved Morosa, and promised not to abandon him, causing Luo Feng to shake his devouring instincts for the first time. Bedi commanded the beast horde to launch a final encirclement. Luo Feng changed tactics during extreme exhaustion: Morosa actively distracted the beasts and disrupted Bedi's rhythm. After being severely wounded, Bedi forcibly evolved. Morosa suggested devouring the remnants of his origin himself, and Luo Feng restrained him with the Lieyuan Art and the Bond Mark. Luo Feng suppressed Bedi's origin, and Morosa won the primordial battle in the Storm of Destruction. With Bedi's fall and the end of the realm beast calamity, Morosa became the only special realm beast under Luo Feng's command. After the battle, Luo Feng realized that this victory relied on higher civilization legacies such as the Star Tower, Jin World, and Lieyuan Technique. Morosa also sensed that the source of destruction lay far behind. Zuoshanke revealed: All three originate from the Origin Continent, where more complete rules exist, as well as the causality between the Jin and Food Kingdoms. Luo Feng understood that going to the Origin Continent was not about leaving home, but about seeking a true way to protect the human race and the Cosmic Sea. After bidding farewell to Xu Xin, Hong, and Thunder God, he took the Star Tower and Morosa into the Reincarnation Passage, heading to the Origin Continent. (Source: Tencent, translated)

The village still retains the strange custom of worshiping "paper brides". Tao Mengyan, who was chosen as the "paper bride", experienced a life-and-death experience in Zangling Village, and finally solved the mystery of her past life and learned the thousand-year-old historical truth of the "Zangzun" belief in Zangling Village. (Source: Tencent, translated)

anime.title: Huo Wang
anime.synopsis: The bizarre laws of Heaven, the extraordinary immortals and Buddhas—are they real? Or are they fake? Lost in confusion, Li Huowang couldn't tell. (Source: Tencent, translated)

anime.title: Zhu Xian Movie: Shi Nian Shu Tu
anime.synopsis: Good and evil clash, destiny is reborn. Watch as Zhang Xiaofan traverses the path of cultivation, defying all odds and breaking through the impasse! (Source: Baidu Baike, translated)

anime.title: Mang Huang Ji (2026)
anime.synopsis: Fate had never been kind to Ji Ning. Wracked by illnesses and infirm his entire life on Earth, Ning knew early on that he would die as a teenager. What he didn’t know was that there really was such a thing as life after death, and that the universe was a far larger place than he thought. A lucky twist of fate (one of the few in Ning’s life) meant that Ning was reborn into a world of Immortals and monsters, of Ki Refiners and powerful Fiendgods, a world where Dynasties lasted for millions of years. A world which is both greater and yet also smaller than he ever could imagine. He would have the opportunity to join them, and in this life, Ning swore to himself, he would never let himself be weak again! The Era he was born into was a Desolate one, but Ning would make it his era. (Source: Novel Update)

anime.title: Dang Shen Bu Rang
anime.synopsis: Yang Jian is the god in heaven who is in charge of eliminating disasters. He will violently and mercilessly destroy any target that brings harm to the three realms. However, the crisis of spiritual energy depletion in the world is imminent, and Yang Jian falls into the human world. Only by learning to influence the monsters in the world with true emotions instead of violence can he complete his mission and return to heaven as a god. Yang Jian, who has no other talent except violence, finds his his former partner Xiaotian Quan (a black dog), reincarnated as a mortal girl by the name of Wang Xiaoxiao, and begins a monster-hunting operation of unprecedented difficulty. (Source: iQIYI, translated)

anime.title: Jian Lai Movie: Wen Sheng Yi Mai
anime.synopsis: It tells the story of the old scholar and his four disciples—Cui Chan, Zuo You, Liu Shiliu, and Qi Jingchun—as they journey from humble alleys to a grand and upright school. After the Three or Four Struggles, Cui Chan rebelled and left the sect, and the Wen Sheng lineage was clearly falling apart. This cultural lineage, weathered by wind and snow, still leaves behind new inheritance... (Source: Tencent, translated)

anime.title: Qingshan
anime.synopsis: After being confined to Qingshan Mental Hospital, the gifted young man Chen Ji kills the enemy who killed his parents. He then accidentally travels back in time to the ancient world and becomes an apprentice at the Ning Dynasty Medical Clinic. Involved in a case involving the Secret Service, he becomes a non-staff member of the agency, only to discover he's also a spy for the enemy nation. The story revolves around this dual identity. Trapped in the maelstrom of power, Chen Ji secretly fights for survival, using modern knowledge to deconstruct spiritual cultivation systems and maneuvering to overturn the chessboard. Ultimately, he transforms from pawn to master, wielding the Qingshan Mountains as his blade, vowing to shatter the hypocrisy of heaven! (Source: Tencent, translated)

anime.title: Chu Wu
anime.synopsis: People become ‘ghouls’ upon dying, and will enter the physical world through a door to cause chaos. Zhang Zha, a mere delivery boy, accidentally entered a haunted house, and resulted in a crisis— a ‘ghoul’ breakout. As such, people from all factions began to make an appearance in the story, while Zhang Zha continues to grow upon experiencing a series of adventures and fights with a mysterious scroll about modern Jianghu slowly unfolding alongside. (Source: MU)

anime.title: Tianyuan
anime.synopsis: Chen Qingyuan, the foremost prodigy of the Northern Wilderness, stepped into the forbidden zone "Tianyuan" a century ago. His soul lamp extinguished, and the world believed him dead. A hundred years later, he emerged alive from the forbidden zone, but his cultivation was completely destroyed, and his past remained a mystery. A mysterious woman in red within Tianyuan made a pact with him, offering two choices: "Marry me" or fulfill nine promises. Chen Qingyuan decisively chose the latter. What he thought was the beginning of a miserable, backbreaking life turned out to be a destiny-bound journey filled with crazy buffs. (Source: iQIYI, translated)

anime.title: Yongbing Tianxia
anime.synopsis: Three unknown mercenaries, with their unyielding spirit, wrote an unparalleled legend that will last through the ages. (Source: iQIYI, translated)

anime.title: Shenguo Zhi Shang 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: Second season of Shenguo Zhi Shang.

anime.title: Huo Feng Liao Yuan San
anime.synopsis: In 193 AD, Guo Jia presented the dark military strategy of "slaughtering one city to subdue ten," leading Cao Cao to attack Xuzhou under the pretext of "avenging his father." Historical records state that "hundreds of thousands of men and women were killed." Liaoyuan Huo, posing as Zhao Yun, aided the people of Xuzhou in their desperate defense, outwitting and outmaneuvering Cao Cao's army, while secretly recruiting Liu Bei to join the fight against Cao Cao. Lu Bu, lying in wait in Chenliu, launched a surprise attack on Cao Cao's rear, following the advice of his strategist Chen Gong. Zhuge Liang and Sima Yi also arrived in Xuzhou, stirring up the war. The Battle of Xuzhou saw Lu Bu, Xu Chu, Dian Wei, Zhao Yun, and other powerful figures engage in a fierce battle that shook the world. After this battle, the tables have turned in Xuzhou. Cao Cao then turns his attention to his powerful northern enemy, and a top-level strategic game that would determine the fate of the world begins. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

anime.title: Wan Xiang Zhi Wang
anime.synopsis: Luolan Mansion, one of the five major mansions of Daxia in Shenzhou Continent, has fallen into decline due to the mysterious disappearance of two mansion masters. Although the young mansion master Li Luo is extremely talented and was born with three phase palaces, he has difficulty practicing because of his natural empty phase. Jiang Qinge, with whom he had been engaged since childhood, has a ninth-grade light phase and is extremely talented. Realizing the gap between them, Li Luo wanted to cancel the contract and break off the engagement, but was rejected by Jiang Qinge. On his seventeenth birthday, Li Luo took away the secret treasure left by his parents and obtained the water light phase, but the price was that his hair turned white overnight and his life was overdrawn. If he wanted to extend his life, he had to reach the state of a marquis within five years. (Source: iQIYI, translated)

anime.title: Lang Lang Shaonu Lan

anime.title: Tian Wai Zhi Men
anime.synopsis: The Tianyan Kingdom possesses twelve of the most powerful weapons in the world, known as the "Twelve Divine Cores." Bai Meng, a female soldier with exceptional strength, is exceptionally chosen to possess one of the Dragon-Patterned Divine Cores, but is treated as a mere ornament due to societal prejudice. Bai Meng is ordered to the Haiyue Kingdom to participate in a martial arts festival, hoping to prove herself, but unexpectedly becomes a murderer, and her Divine Core is "absorbed" and stolen by the local leader, Duan Tian! To clear her name and retrieve the Divine Core, Bai Meng engages in a battle of wits and courage with Duan Tian, ​​unfolding a series of thrilling life-or-death struggles, only to discover an even greater conspiracy hidden behind it all… In this treacherous world, who is the pawn, and who is the player? When survival hangs in the balance, where will their differing beliefs lead them? (Source: Tencent, translated)

anime.title: Fan Ying
anime.synopsis: The Pure Sea's currents flow from north to south, constantly flowing through this world. People build homes and thrive on the backs of giant beasts. Every wish has its response. The deity known as Fan Ying warns that only by letting your wishes run wild can you reap the rewards of miracles and survive. However, the unchanging rules are about to change, and those who transcend fate will eventually follow the origin of all things. (Source: Tencent, Google translated)

anime.title: Bai Ri Cheng Cai
anime.synopsis: In the high tower world where money is paramount, follow the grassroots male protagonist to climb to the top of the tower and realize his counterattack plan of becoming rich in 100 days! (Source: Bilibili, translated)

anime.title: Lun Hui Leyuan
anime.synopsis: Traversing countless worlds, reborn through endless quests, a blood-stained pact forged a night of beheadings. A merciless blade swept across the seven paradises, scattering countless heads and transforming the hunter Su Xiao into a terrifying symbol. Yet, even as killing became a daily routine, life and death a minor matter, he could not forget the death of his parents. The sinister smile of the gray gentleman beneath his hat, the eerie totems rising from corpses, and the oppressive might of the ancient god in the darkness gradually revealed the truth of that year. Chasing the true culprit, carrying on the legacy of the extermination of the law, and restoring balance to the elements became his inevitable destiny. (Source: Tencent, translated)

anime.title: Wangzhe Rongyao: Rongyao Zhi Zhang - Baozang Pian
anime.synopsis: Bounty hunter Marco Polo wanders the Kingdom of Kings and happens to take in Luban No. 7, a mechanical manipulator separated from Master Luban. To retrieve the "Tuling Treasure Box" tucked away in Luban No. 7, Marco accompanies Luban No. 7 on a quest to find Master Luban's family. However, they fall prey to an enemy conspiracy. From the Cloud Desert to the underground city of Chang'an, the two, having forged a deep friendship, face even more formidable challenges together. (Source: Tencent, Google translated)
