anime.title: Chao Neng Fuke Jing
anime.synopsis: Gods descended, disasters were rampant! When the gods invaded the earth, the superpowers with the mysterious "leaf pattern" became the last sword and shield of mankind. While the two superpower academies in the East and the West, Gou Chen and Adam, were fighting hard, a Chinese boy quietly rose up. He had the ability to replicate superpowers, and with a mortal body, he held the power of the world and would eventually kill the gods. This is the carnival of the godslayers! (Source: iQIYI, translated)

anime.title: Tao Yu Moshi Zhi Shu
anime.synopsis: Set in a new world of the two major races—the mechanical humans and beast spirits—the protagonist Black Eyed Stone inherits an old friend's wish. To settle the grudges between the two races, the main cast sets out to unlock information hidden in masks distributed in four temples within the beast spirit territories, find the legendary "White Statue," and use its powers to restore the world and resolve all conflicts. (Source: Tencent, translated)

anime.title: Xue Zhong Han Dao Xing
anime.synopsis: After a three-year, six-thousand-mile odyssey, Xu Fengnian, the world's most dissolute playboy, returns to Beiliang. Facing his father, Xu Xiao, he realizes that the Northern Liang sword will ultimately be his own. This time, his servant, Old Huang, offers his life as a token of his loyalty, respectfully inviting the prince into the martial arts world. Xu Fengnian no longer hides his power, but boldly draws his sword, facing the dual threat of the imperial court and the martial arts world, realizing his master plan and gradually uncovering the truth behind his mother, Wu Su's, death. (Source: Tencent, translated)

anime.title: Shaonian Ge Xing: Nanming Li Huo
anime.synopsis: After the Heaven-Splitting Sword was drawn, the divine weapons scattered across the land began to show unusual signs. Xiao Se, together with several sworn friends from the jianghu, set out to seek the divine weapons and save the world. (Source: Youku)

anime.title: Zi Heian Zhong Zou Lai
anime.synopsis: Li Hai, a soldier leader who is tired of killing, transforms himself into a valley detective and hides in the city. He wants to live an ordinary life, but unexpectedly opens up a new world of extraordinary people. The darkness follows him like a shadow and there is no escape from it, so he goes back and defeats him! (Source: iQIYI, translated)

anime.title: Shenhai Yujin
anime.synopsis: Zhou Ming travels back in time and becomes Captain Duncan of the Lost Homeland, a terrifying evil god known as the Moving Scourge. In this deep-sea world created by an ancient god, the old order has been shattered, and isolated island cities are the only remaining lights of civilization. Yet, the shadows of the past lurk within the depths. Captain Duncan leads a diverse crew, delving into the perilous depths, and gradually begins to uncover history, glimpsing a glimpse of a despairing truth. (Source: Tencent, translated)

anime.title: Jian Ke
anime.synopsis: In the Sanlin Star Region of the Federation, Xu Le, an orphan from the Donglin area, works as a clerk in the shop of the mechanic Feng Yu. Feng Yu teaches Xu Le mechanic techniques and ancient martial arts moves. But one day, Feng Yu is hunted down by the Federation military, and Xu Le is inexplicably implicated and becomes a wanted criminal of the Federation. After witnessing Feng Yu's "death," Xu Le uses the chip left by Feng Yu to replace his own chip (which also confuses him as to who he is?) and changes his identity to study at Xinglihua University in the capital, where he meets Jian Shuier who's superstar of the Federation, Tai Zhiyuan who's a former royal family member of the Federation, Shi Qinghai who's a spy from Qinglong Mountain, and Zhang Xiaomeng who's a spy from Qinglong Mountain. He also drives a mecha for the first time and fights... (Source: iQIYI, translated)

anime.title: Baise Shandian 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: That summer, the girls met through table tennis. Now, that white light shines once more. The story of these table tennis girls is about to turn a new page. (Source: Official Weibo Account)

anime.title: Hua Jianghu: Bu Liang Ren Ba
anime.synopsis: Having survived a life-or-death ordeal in the northern deserts, Li Xingyun finally returns to his homeland. Faced with the sudden changes at Huan Yin Fang and the many mysteries surrounding Ji Ruxue, how will he break through the predicament? In this world, grudges are easily settled, but the boat of the heart is hard to cross. Crisis resurfaces in the Central Plains; let's see how Bu Liang Ren once again quell the turmoil! (Source: Tencent, translated)

anime.title: Shenmi Fusu
anime.synopsis: "My name is Yang Jian, and by the time you read this, I'll be dead." Ordinary student Yang Jian is caught up in a bizarre invasion, acquiring parchment from the future and a mysterious eye, becoming a ghost wielder. Yang Jian and his classmates escape the campus, but the crisis is just beginning. In this sinister world, the human world is a prison. The price of peering into darkness is eternal loss amidst endless wonder. (Source: Tencent, translated)

anime.title: Tian Guan Xueyuan
anime.synopsis: To resist invasions from other worlds, the Heavenly Great Sage founded Tianguan Academy. Every year, the Academy would recruit new students—but in the end, only nine could become the official Heavenly Officers. Gu Tian, a young soccer player, accidentally awakened his hidden power while saving someone on the field. Invited by his senior Xia Zhi, he boarded Subway Line 36 to Tianguan Academy. With the world's finest teachers, strict assessments, and a brutal elimination system, the Academy pushes its students to the limit. By a stroke of fortune, Gu Tian became the 81st student to pass the entrance trial. Under the guidance of celestial masters, he studied spells and divine decrees, honed his combat skills against powerful rivals, and strode forward step by step toward the ultimate goal of becoming one of the Nines. (Source: Youku)

anime.title: Sheng Xu Movie: Lu Jin Liaoyuan
anime.synopsis: The Great Sacrifice of the Mysterious Clan: To protect the heavens, the Celestial Emperor of the Heavens fought desperately against the Mysterious Army, leaving only Meng Hai and Luo alive. In this moment of crisis, the Desolate Heavenly Emperor, who had fought against the progenitor of the Mysterious Clan, arrived with a single sword strike, leaving behind the prophecy, "In the vast heavens, there will always be those who come," before standing alone before the Mysterious Plateau. Chu Feng, an Earthling from the Lesser Underworld, with the help of a mysterious stone jar, traversed the Kunlun Mountain Cycle of Reincarnation, evading the Reincarnation Hunters, and arrived in the Yang Realm of the myriad planes; unaware that the Cholera Reincarnators were hunting him down across countless realms. Forced by the relentless pursuit of the Reincarnation Hunters, Chu Feng attempted to forcefully break through his cultivation realm, but at that moment, his body suddenly underwent a transformation, rendering him unable to continue cultivating. With all paths in the world blocked, how will Chu Feng break through this predicament and find his own Great Dao...? (Source: Douban, translated)

anime.title: Zi Chuan 3rd Season
anime.synopsis: Once, they swore to protect this land; later, they buried that era with their own hands. This season, we witness Bataan's rebirth from the brink of death, the gleaming armor of the expedition, and the fateful judgment known as the "Rebellion of the Three Heroes." When the threat of the demons recedes, the demons within people awaken. Torn between loyalty and ambition, the Three Heroes face the longest winter of their lives. The stars will never fall, Zichuan will endure forever—but can you afford the price? (Source: Tencent, translated)

anime.title: Cheng Li Laile Liao Yi Tiao Long
anime.synopsis: (No synopsis yet.)

anime.title: Xing Men
anime.synopsis: A path of revenge, a testament to the spirit of the martial world. (Source: Douban, translated)

anime.title: Da Zhou Zhen Hun Ren
anime.synopsis: In order to resist the foreign evil organization that intends to destroy the Great Zhou Kingdom, the genius wizard Zuo Xiao gathered four sacred artifacts, practiced the five elements magic, protected the dragon veins of the Great Zhou Kingdom, and defeated the foreign evil forces one by one. (Source: Youku, Google translated)

anime.title: Dadao Zhishang
anime.synopsis: It combines folklore, strange stories, cultivation system and suspense and conspiracy to construct a world where ghosts and gods are rampant and ancient and strange are intertwined. The work is characterized by the unique "oriental mystery". (Source: Tencent, translated)

anime.title: Wuzhuang Fengbao
anime.synopsis: The young human Wang Dong vowed to avenge his parents and joined the Storm Squad, determined to exterminate the Zhage insect species across the solar system. Through hardships, he awakened his Blade Warrior powers, upgraded his armor and skills, and ultimately uncovered the insects' ultimate plot on Earth along with his team. Facing overwhelming swarms, Wang activated his ultimate Blade Warrior form and defeated both human traitors and the insect leader Ying Yuan. (Source: Youku)

anime.title: Ta Xing
anime.synopsis: A scientific expedition from Blue Star discovered a strange humanoid corpse exposed in a vacuum on the planet Minglong. The expedition brought it back to Blue Star for research, but unexpectedly, they also brought disaster. The energy emanating from the humanoid corpse caused the entire Blue Star biosphere to enter a state of supernatural evolution. Fortunately, the humans on Blue Star were also within the biosphere and entered the supernatural evolutionary sequence, successively evolving into: Human-level, Earth-level, and Celestial-level evolvers. The seven most powerful Celestial-level evolvers were known as the Seven Sages of Hanxia, ​​protecting Hanxia in this chaotic world fraught with calamities. The anomalies on Blue Star attracted the attention of the Great Yu Empire, which ruled this star field. The Great Yu Empire believed that these anomalies might be related to a fugitive they were hunting. Therefore, taking advantage of the emergence of the Tenth Academy of the Starry Sky, they issued an academy trial, attracting a large number of students from combat academies to Blue Star under the guise of trials to find the fugitive and hone their new blood. On Blue Star, a young man named Lu Yin lies in hiding. He is unaware of his identity and origins; his earliest memories are of a bloody massacre, leaving him alone and stranded on Blue Star. As Blue Star undergoes a dramatic transformation, he realizes this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. He needs a clean new identity to return to that dangerous starry sea and seek revenge for the blood debts of the past. Thus, Lu Yin, the Seven Sages of Hanxia, ​​students of the Great Yu Empire, and various other forces enter the scene. On Blue Star, an unprecedented evolution and hunt is about to begin. (Source: iQIYI, translated)

anime.title: Ye Wujiang
anime.synopsis: In the eternal night, a young man shatters the shackles of fate, defies all gods and demons, and forges a new legend of fantasy with a passionate battle song! (Source: iQIYI, translated)

anime.title: Wo You Yi Jian
anime.synopsis: A fallen prince unexpectedly obtains an ancient divine sword, fights his way through the three realms, and ultimately rises to godhood! (Source: iQIYI, translated)

anime.title: Shi Yiren
anime.synopsis: A low-level office worker accidentally consumed a demon and underwent a mutation. Struggling to survive, he hunted evil, seeking light and justice. (Source: Youku)

anime.title: Kai (ONA)
anime.synopsis: In an out-of-control world, survivors faced a thrilling and perilous apocalyptic battlefield. (Source: Youku)

anime.title: Ye Bu Shou
anime.synopsis: 2283, in a post-nuclear wasteland, Fortress City 021 was controlled by Ark Corporation. Their so-called "Savior Guardians" appeared to protect humanity but secretly conducted human experiments using X chips and manipulated public opinion. Young Han Che witnessed his brother's murder by the false Guardians and unexpectedly awakened the "1307 Source System" within him, gaining superpowers. He joined the Yebushou organization, rebuilt by Guan Shanhu, and fought alongside hacker Tian Xin and engineer Kang Di. Yebushou infiltrated Ark training camps and Ghost Island Prison, exposing a plot to create a superpowered army using experiments and mutants. As Han Che unlocked new abilities and faced formidable enemies like Emperor Angel and Divine-Eye Immortal, he embarked on a path of vengeance, truth, and salvation. However, the hidden AI "Lefu" was plotting to control all human consciousness. (Source: Youku)

anime.title: Saibo Jian Xian Tie Yu
anime.synopsis: Fang Bailu, a modern terminally ill patient, wakes up after being frozen for a thousand years in a world where prosperous cyber and ancient cultivation are blended. He embarks on a journey to fight against destiny and face the disaster of the resurrection of a mysterious immortal. (Source: iQIYI, translated)

anime.title: Heiye Qishi
anime.synopsis: In 2145, a century after the nuclear apocalypse triggered by the "New Human Project," which aimed to fully unleash humanity's potential, the surviving humans established a new social order on the wasteland. In this new world built upon technology, superpowers, and magic, Jiang Li, the only "complete New Human," awakens from hibernation and begins his legendary story. (Source: Youku, translated)

anime.title: Yi Wanjia Zhi Ming
anime.synopsis: In the city, people lived under the protection of a barrier, enjoying a peaceful life. Secretly, the Fortune Star agents of the Sword Bureau had been battling the calamity creatures for decades. When Fortune Star agents were kidnapped, the creatures swarmed the city, bringing devastation. The reclusive youth Chen Kefan, competing in an e-sports tournament, encountered an invasion of bloodblade bugs and witnessed the killer of his parents reappear. In the desperate fight, his latent Fortune Star power awakened, setting him on a path of revenge. Yet, as he and his comrades fought bloodily and risked their lives, they discovered that the apocalypse was merely a game played by the gods. (Source: Youku)

anime.title: Xian Jian Qi Xia Zhuan Si
anime.synopsis: For the sake of their cultivation endeavors, the Qionghua Sect sent its elders to forge two swords, Wangshu and Xihe, and sought two disciples to wield them in dual cultivation, attempting to bind the demon realm and seize its immense spiritual power. This ultimately triggered a great war between humans and demons, resulting in heavy casualties on both sides. During this time, Su Yu, the host of Wangshu, disagreed with the Qionghua Sect's cultivation philosophy and left the sect with Yun Tianqing. The demon realm seized the opportunity to escape, and the Qionghua Sect's leader perished in the war. The two married on Qingluan Peak and had a son, Yun Tianhe. They both died young due to the icy cold that invaded their bodies. Young Yun Tianhe grew up alone on Qingluan Mountain. He was unaware of his parents' past, and the unexpected arrival of Han Lingsha set the wheels of fate turning once more. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

anime.title: Wan Ye Zhi Zhu
anime.synopsis: Prince Ning Ming was chosen by a demon star and became the source of corruption in the world. To discover his origins and cleanse the corruption, he joined a secret agency. On his quest for the truth, the powerful Lord of the Ming granted Ning Ming extraordinary abilities, the supreme Emperor of the Zhou protected him, the daring Nightingale sisters favored him, and various prodigies willingly risked everything to help him cleanse the world of corruption. As he neared the truth, Ning Ming witnessed the world's cruelty and vowed to eliminate all corruption and save humanity. (Source: Youku)

anime.title: Xing Lu
anime.synopsis: Under the grand strategy of interstellar travel, humanity has entered the space age, but simultaneously faces the threat of UMA, a high-dimensional extraterrestrial life form from Ganymede, a being capable of devouring human consciousness and evolving itself. Xu Xinghe, a bright student who should be pursuing higher education, witnesses his brother being devoured by the alien creature, awakens special abilities, and embarks on a journey to find his brother's consciousness and fight against UMA. Along the way, he partners with the mysterious girl Jiang Yao, and the fate of humanity and UMA is about to reach a major turning point. (Source: Tencent, translated)

anime.title: Bai Gui Ri Xing
anime.synopsis: A parasitized boy killed his cruel master and became the strongest supernatural hunter. Using his bizarre form, he hunted the mysterious, ultimately transforming into a "Mad Killing God," saving humanity at the cost of everything he cherished. (Source: Youku)

anime.title: Guanglin Diqiu
anime.synopsis: Aliens mistake "animation" for military information. Agent "Xiguang" is ordered to sneak into the earth to investigate the truth about animation. He encounters the earth girl "Qingyan". The two form the most unreliable interstellar investigation team in history and embark on a bizarre, ridiculous and magical journey. (Source: Tencent, translated)

anime.title: Shi Shen
anime.synopsis: (No synopsis yet.)

anime.title: Tianxia Wushuang: Fubing Cheng Pian
anime.synopsis: The King returns, unrivaled in the world! It is a story about falling to the bottom and returning to the top. (Source: iQIYI, translated)

anime.title: Xiang Wang Shi
anime.synopsis: The whale swallowed the present world, and the human race was in trouble. The boy practiced the "forgetfulness technique" at the cost of his memory to prevent the catastrophe! Will they live together in the face of adversity, or will they forget each other in the arena? (Source: iQIYI, translated)

anime.title: Zhu Shen Yu Xi
anime.synopsis: Sixteen gods descended to the human world, tearing the world into countless fragments, transforming them into a life-or-death chessboard called the "Game of Faith." Humans became players, forced to enter bizarre instances every seven days, struggling to survive within the rules set by the gods. Cheng Shi, trapped on a rooftop in a desperate situation at the start, first believed in fate, then succumbed to deception, becoming a clown priest whose every word was a lie. The price was being plagued by misfortune, but his ability was to turn fiction into reality with lies. He used his silver tongue to deceive his teammates and manipulate the gods, running a tightrope between "faith" and "betrayal," rising from a pawn to become the one wielding the pieces. Opposing destinies, sixteen faiths, and six professions combine to create endless gameplay; the instances have diverse themes, the rules are fraught with danger, and the battles of wits and reversals are nested layer upon layer. This is the ultimate game of free will versus destiny—when the pawns begin to awaken, the gods must step down. (Source: iQIYI, translated)

anime.title: Tuer Ni Wudile Xiashan Qu Ba
anime.synopsis: The Ye family was suddenly massacred—Ye Beichen's parents and brothers were slaughtered, and he himself was ruthlessly thrown into the moat, clinging to life by a thread. Rescued by his senior sister, he was taken to Kunlun Mountain, where he spent five grueling years mastering martial arts. Five years later, he returned in full force, armed with the peerless skills taught by 99 invincible masters. Back in the mortal world, when faced with old enemies and powerful factions, Ye Beichen showed no fear. With extraordinary martial prowess and overwhelming strength, he unleashed chaos across the city, carving a path of revenge and dominance—turning the tables and crushing all who once sought his downfall. (Source: Youku)

anime.title: Wo Bushi Xi Shen
anime.synopsis: Human civilization will never be extinguished! In a world where calamity descends, the young Chen Ling uses drama to prove the way and defy fate to become a god in a bizarre world where "books, doctors, soldiers, zither, chess, puppets, witches, divination, theft, and prostitution" are intertwined! (Source: iQIYI, translated)

anime.title: Liangyao
anime.synopsis: It tells the story of a group of heroes in a fictional world where all medicines are forbidden. A wandering swordsman named Shao Xia, an amnesiac pharmacist named Wuming, a passionate constable named Susu, and a royal pharmacist named Xu Changqing form an alliance while searching for a mysterious monster. They gradually uncover the dark truth behind the city. The group must choose between trust and betrayal, power and consequences, attempting to save themselves and others in this unbalanced world. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

anime.title: Bie Jiao Wo Emo
anime.synopsis: This hero who can save the world seems like a demon! Subversive, absurd, and sharp! Witness the ultimate "working class" hero's heroic comeback to protect the lights of every home! (Source: iQIYI, translated)

anime.title: Jinji Xingzhe
anime.synopsis: On the world's dark edge, forbidden powers are growing. When high schooler Yan Feng is drawn into a deadly incident, he joins a secret organization to save his sister, contain sinister artifacts, and battle villains bent on unleashing these powers. As the fight intensifies, he begins to uncover the truth about his own origins. (Source: Youku)

anime.title: Hai Ru Shenming

anime.title: Kkokdu
anime.synopsis: Jacob, an 11-year-old boy who is looking for kokdu dolls to remember his last moments with his grandmother, accidentally enters the world of these dolls. The "kokdu", literally "funeral doll", a key element in the work, is a wooden doll that adorned the bier (a carriage that carried a coffin) in the funeral culture of the Joseon Dynasty. It was considered a being that accompanied and protected the deceased, so that they would not feel lonely on their way to the afterlife. These dolls, which appeared in various forms, such as warriors, servants, clowns, and guides, embody the philosophy of Joseon-era Koreans, who viewed death not as something to be feared, but as a warm farewell and a new journey. While Subaru is kind and shy, Hokuto has exuberance to spare, and her favorite pastime is designing bold matching outfits for the two of them to wear. anime.synopsis: In the midst of a fierce battle at Azuchi Castle during Japan's Sengoku period, a young samurai named ZAN suddenly hears the mysterious voice of a girl coming out of nowhere. This new world is controlled by a ruler named RIKKA, who maintains order using a symbolic entity of life known as the "Trope." Trapped in the middle of a conflict and forced to face brutal battles against powerful enemies and Trope creatures, ZAN begins to question the meaning of the "justice" that had always been fought for. Determined to uncover the absolute truth about this mysterious realm, ZAN decides to forge ahead. ZAN is not alone—the samurai embarks on this journey alongside Panther, a mechanical tiger-like creature, and Uzume, the mysterious girl who brought ZAN to this dimension. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Takate
anime.synopsis: When his master dies, Gang Yong pledges to avenge his teacher at all costs. After training his martial arts skills in seclusion, Gang Yong sets off to hunt down the traitors and make them pay! But when he gets to town, he discovers they're... already dead? Well, what's he supposed to do now?! (Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

anime.title: Akuyaku Reijou no Tsuihougo! Kyoukai Kaikaku Gohan de Yuuyuu Sister-gurashi
anime.synopsis: Reincarnated as the villainess, Elizabeth Fontini fought against her fate, but it was all for naught. Repeated misunderstandings compounded with unfortunate circumstances lead to her inevitable downfall, and Elizabeth is banished to the nunnery. However, what most thought to be punishment is actually Elizabeth's long-awaited freedom! Life as a sister isn't too bad, but her short respite is muddled by the arrival of Leonid Guardhelm, the head knight of her former kingdom. Not even he can put a damper on the optimistic girl's mood. Utilizing her past life's experiences as an event planner, Elizabeth sets out to revolutionize culinary arts and bring a sweet flavor to everyone's lives, one home-cooked dish at a time. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

anime.title: Starlight Project (Shinsaku Animation Zoku-hen)
anime.synopsis: A new anime sequel for the Starlight Project series.

anime.title: Special Kid Factory
anime.synopsis: The suspense sci-fi anime takes place in a future where unbeknownst to the people of Earth, there wages an interstellar war spanning the entire universe. Alien arms dealers control our world from behind the scenes, using it as a supersoldier factory where "special kids" with unique abilities are abducted to fight in wars on the other side of the universe. When one "special kid" escapes captivity and journeys back to earth, a seemingly ordinary boy discovers he is a body double for the family all while being drawn unarmed into the heart of a space war. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Ryuugeshou no Shinobi
anime.synopsis: Tokyo, 2029. Long believed to have vanished after the asteroid impact that caused their extinction, dinosaurs secretly survived by passing their DNA into humanity through interbreeding. Hidden among ordinary people, they now prey upon humans while living unnoticed within society. Standing against them is a covert order of ninjas who wield Ryugesho, a special pigment infused with ancient memories. By applying this mysterious pigment, they awaken the powers of dinosaurs within themselves and fight back against the predators threatening humanity. As the dinosaurs launch their campaign to wipe out humankind, the ninjas rise to stop them. The battle for the survival of two species begins. (Source: Official website)

anime.title: Ousama no Propose
anime.synopsis: With looks to die for, Saika Kuozaki is the most powerful mage in existence and the only one who can thwart the annihilation factors that attempt to destroy the world once every three hundred hours. When Saika is mortally wounded, however, she bequeaths both her powers and body to the normal high school boy who happens to find her, Mushiki Kuga. Just because Mushiki inherits her abilities, though, doesn't mean he can control them. To stand a chance of saving the world, Mushiki will have to attend an academy for mages as Saika—while trying to keep his true identity under wraps! (Source: Yen Press)

anime.title: Sailor Zombie
anime.synopsis: Two months have passed since a zombie epidemic began. Despite the chaos around, three high school students in sailor suits live ordinary school lives. Maiko is a transfer student. She hopes to become an idol. Even though Maiko goes through various incidents, her friendship with Momoka and Mutsumi deepens. One day, zombies attack people. Music comes out from the radio and the zombies stop their attack to dance. With this type of music, humans are protected from the zombies, but they can't find the music source. Since then, Maiko, Momoka and Mutsumi are threatened by the zombies. (Source: Asian Wiki)

anime.title: Mii-chan to Yamada-san
anime.synopsis: In the heart of Shinjuku, there are a variety of host and hostess nightclubs open to customers seeking a night of indulgence with a gorgeous companion. Yamada is one of those companions. She balances university and work, but finds herself more interested in becoming a model hostess than a star pupil. The pay is too tempting to resist, which is why so many girls come and go in the industry. But in 2012, she meets someone completely different. Mii-chan is a petite young woman who seems to be rather useless at most things—barely able to read or write and, unfortunately, clumsy—earning her ridicule from staff and customers alike. However, her bright energy and endless motivation proves hard to ignore, and Yamada finds herself drawn in by Mii-chan's charm. A beautiful and tragic story about an unlikely friendship and the unfortunate end that separated them forever. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

anime.title: Kimi wa Yotsuba no Clover
anime.synopsis: The romantic suspense manga centers around Uichi, a once popular student who is now relentlessly bullied in high school. Still, he strives everyday to keep a promise to Yotsuha (his first love from elementary school before she transferred schools) to become a veterinarian. Just as he reaches his limit with the bullying, Yotsuha suddenly appears before him. She has seemingly not changed since back then — except she harbors only one hidden resolve deep in her eyes. (Source: ANN)

anime.title: Danzai sareta Akuyaku Reijou wa, Gyakkou shite Kanpeki na Akujo wo Mezasu
anime.synopsis: Claudia, daughter of a duke, is tricked by her wicked half-sister and sold off to a brothel. Unwilling to accept defeat, Claudia uses the tools at her disposal and becomes one of the most successful sex workers in her new home. That's when she dies—only to be thrust back in time to age fourteen! Gone is the gullible girl of her academy days now that she's got street savvy and hard-won seductive skills. It's Claudia's turn to play the evil villainess, and there's nothing she won't do to protect what's hers! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

anime.title: Ultraman: Darkness Heels
anime.synopsis: Anime adaptation for the Ultraman franchise's Darkness Heels project.

anime.title: Koishita Hito wa, Imouto no Kawari ni Shindekure to Itta. Imouto to Kekkon shita Kataomoi Aite ga Naze Imasara Watashi no Moto ni? To Omottara
anime.synopsis: Lady Wisteria's greatest wish is to be worthy of the man she loves, Lord Bright. But when Wisteria's little sister, Rosalie, is selected to enter the Predawn Realm as its guardian, never to return, Bright begs Wisteria to take Rosalie's place! After all, Wisteria is skilled with magic, and resistant to the sinister miasma that threatens the mortal world. Heartbroken, Wisteria enters the Predawn Realm, accompanied by the sacred sword, Sartis. More than twenty years later, a stranger with a familiar face appears, demanding the sword and challenging Wisteria. Who is he, and why does he resemble Lord Bright...? (Source: Tokyopop)

anime.title: Bad End Mokuzen no Heroine ni Tensei shita Watashi, Konse dewa Renai suru Tsumori ga Cheat na Ani ga Hanashite Kuremasen!?
anime.synopsis: A dating sim enthusiast wakes up in the body of Reine Waynewright: an adorable otome heroine in a fantasy game! Reine discovers that in this world, she's a lowly F-rank student at the magical Heartfelt Academy, bullied by her classmates and snubbed by her love interests for her lack of talent. Determined to avoid a Bad Ending, Reine resolves to study hard, practice her magic, and pass the exams to increase her rank! If she grinds hard enough, she may be able to change her fate: make new friends, improve herself, and maybe even fall in love along the way! (Source: Tokyopop)

anime.title: Ikyou no Tsume Nuri Minarai
anime.synopsis: Keiko Sahara, an office worker with a hobby in gel nails, is suddenly transported to a world where magic is used through nails. In this world, "Nail Painters" create spells by painting magical materials onto nails. By chance, Keiko becomes a nail painter apprentice and begins a new life in this other world, working alongside eccentric master sorcerer Rocco, his apprentice Hou, and her nail painting mentor Lido. This is a workplace fantasy about her journey as a nail painter in a magical realm. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Kaijuu Decode: Aidara no Yubiwa
anime.synopsis: Set in Sakai, a youth named Maru lives in the peaceful city, a society freed from the restrictions of the body, mind, space, and time. In contrast, a girl named Coco, a member of the Aidara Tribe, resides in the Zone, a treacherous area also inhabited by incredible beasts. The story revolves around two opposing characters seeking a path into a shared future. (Source: Sakai Film Office, edited)

anime.title: [Watashi no Ofuru de Waruin dakedo] to Okaasama (Heroine) ni Torimaki wo Oshitsukerare, Totsuida Henkyou demo Yome Atsukai Saremasen ga, Okage de Jiyuu ni Ikiraremasu!
anime.synopsis: After being handed one of her mother's attendants as a fiancé and effectively kicked out of the royal palace, a young noblewoman begins an uneasy new life in her husband's household. The atmosphere is anything but welcoming, though her expressionless husband seems surprisingly kind. With her beloved dolls as companions, she settles into her new home, only to find herself with far too much free time. This is the start of a lighthearted marriage story about unexpected bonds, quiet days, and the dolls who make them a little less lonely. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Aisanai to Iwaremashitemo: Moto Maou no Hakushaku Reijou wa Kimajime Gunjin ni Ezuke wo Sarete Shiawase ni Naru
anime.synopsis: Unused to humans, Abigail panics when her new husband declares that he'll never love her on the first night of their political marriage. Does that mean she's not allowed to eat?! A new twist on the food-based romance tale, starring an earl's daughter who was the Monster King in her previous life! After years of neglect by her old family, Abigail will charm her sincere military husband and his household one bite at a time and find her happy ending! (Source: Cross Infinite World)

anime.title: Daikaijuu Gaea-tima
anime.synopsis: A gigantic monster devastates a small, seaside town. Ten years later, the resilient community has emerged as a tourist destination, when the monster, known as Gaea-tima, returns. Miyako, a local hero and survivor of the first attack, pushes to find a scientific solution to the problem of the giant creatures known as "gigantis." But is humanity capable of responding to violence with anything except more violence? (Source: Kodansha USA)

anime.title: Godzilla (Shinsaku Anime)
anime.synopsis: New series for the Godzilla franchise.

anime.title: Eat-Man: The Over Order
anime.synopsis: He devours metal and can regenerate any weapon—Bolt Crank, a mysterious adventurer. He speaks nothing of his past and reveals nothing of his purpose. Taking on requests and traveling across the world, countless incidents and fateful encounters await him on his journey. Meetings and farewells, lost memories, things someone has lost, things someone tried to protect, and the truth sleeping somewhere in the world. Carrying untold stories with him, Bolt Crank continues to walk. (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Manshuu Ahen Squad
anime.synopsis: "Here in Manchuria, the cheapest thing you'll find is a person's life." In 1937, Isamu Higata is sent to the Japan-controlled Chinese puppet state of Manchukuo to serve in its standing army. After losing sight in his right eye during battle, he's banished to an agricultural facility where he's constantly abused by the commanding officers. Then, in a dusty corner, he discovers a field of poppies, the raw materials for opium. In order to raise money for his seriously ill mother, Isamu decides to produce the illicit drug—a choice that sends his future and the fate of all Manchuria into directions unknown. (Source: K Manga)

anime.title: Dorei kara no Kitai to Hyouka no Sei de Sakushu Dekinai no da ga
anime.synopsis: Allen is reborn in a new world, and a goddess gives him a cheat skill called Regeneration. It can heal any injury or disease, but there isn't much call for that, so he comes up with a plan: heal a group of slave girls and settle into a slow life with a harem. It doesn't go the way he pictured. Once the girls are fully healed, their own abilities turn out to be far beyond his. The crops grow almost overnight, and the living conditions improve just as fast. Allen keeps getting edged out of any useful role. He falls back on the modern knowledge from his past life, but the girls pick that up too and turn it into a hugely successful business. Allen is slowly fading into the background of his own story...?! (Source: MAL News)

anime.title: Mr. Clice
anime.synopsis: Mr. Clice is a story centering on a super dashing spy, the special agent member of Japan's elite espionage program Jin Clice, whose body was mortally wounded by the KGB. The agency had already invested a lot of money in him, so they would not allow him to die so easily. In an act of desperation, in order to save him, the government transferred Jin Clice's personality into a new body, which happens to be that of a lovely young beautiful woman! (a recently dead tennis player), because they could not afford the cost to make him into a cyborg. The dashing ladies man has, in essence, gone from being Bond to being the Bond girl! (Source: MU)

anime.title: Sugar Sugar Rune (Unknown)
anime.synopsis: The queen of the Magical World is selected through a competition in which two young witches travel to the Human World to gather the hearts of boys who fall in love with them. This time, best friends Chocolat Meilleure and Vanilla Mieux, the daughters of the previous queen candidates, enroll in a human school in order to commence the challenge. Aided by their familiar spirits and mentor Rockin Robin, the young witches learn to adjust to human life as each aims to become the next queen. Chocolat, who is popular with boys in the Magical World, finds that her strategies do not work well for capturing human hearts. In contrast, Vanilla's quiet and shy personality seems to make her the center of attraction. To make matters more complicated, a mysterious boy by the name of Pierre Tempête de Neige seems to be after Chocolat's heart. The two witches' friendship is put to the test as the competition intensifies. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

anime.title: Wakareru Tame ni Irojikake shitemita
anime.synopsis: All Makoto wants to do is to break up with his boyfriend, but he just keep getting more addicted to him?! After a night of drinking, Makoto unexpectedly starts dating Yagi. Determined to end things, Makoto has tried to break up over 50 times, but all his attempts have failed. If this continues, he'll have to do whatever it takes to make Yagi hate him. Yagi claims he doesn't like aggressive people, so Makoto tries to use that to his advantage... but everything backfires! And just like that, things take an unexpected turn...?! (Source: Coolmic)

anime.title: Danbi wa Kkaebi
anime.synopsis: Danbi and Kebi is a stop-motion series for preschoolers, featuring a four-year-old girl named Danbi and her magical fairy friend Kebi who often unfold a world of imagination. They are free spirited with silly sense of humour and depend on each other through thick and thin, and turn anything ordinary into a fun, fantastical playground of imagination. (Source: Official page)
